ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure is a quadrilateral; the two slanted sides on the left and right have identical arrow markings, indicating that these two sides are parallel. The upper side of the quadrilateral connects these two parallel sides; the upper-left interior angle is labeled 96°, and the upper-right interior angle is labeled (2x)°. Reasoning: According to the specified method, regard the upper side as a transversal; it intersects the left and right two parallel sides. 96° and (2x)° are same-side interior angles, so they are supplementary: 96 + 2x = 180. Solving gives 2x = 84, therefore x = 42.

raw_record.question_text: Find the value of the variable $x$ in the figure.

method.method_draft: Read the figure as a quadrilateral whose left and right sides have matching arrow marks, so those two sides are parallel. The top side acts as a transversal cutting the parallel sides. The top-left interior angle is labeled 96° and the top-right interior angle is labeled (2x)°. Since same-side interior angles between parallel lines are supplementary, set 96 + 2x = 180. Then 2x = 84, so x = 42.
